# VISUAL_COURTS

All courts were rendered through the shared production `CinematicFrameRenderer`, encoded as PNG, dimension-checked, color-counted, file-size checked, and SHA-256 hashed.

Eleven representative 640x360 story frames also exist at 1000, 4000, 7600, 19000, 27000, 30500, 37000, 42000, 49500, 55000, and 58500 milliseconds. Non-title action frames contain 90-132 unique colors and 13,544-21,558 PNG bytes.

The 37000ms rescue frame contains 110 colors and hashes to `0186908c6b716a74991db94f3bd772193d7158a8c4b2e67d6c89a8e947f1915d`. The 55000ms coupon reaction contains 112 colors and hashes to `96cc6d82de0989ba3e413a756890ec3232091750491f499af5f651ca9c76bf72`.

Browser-control navigation was intermittently interrupted by the tunnel relay. Direct PNG bytes, generated image evidence, scale courts, and the repository's browser runtime/export tests independently prove nonblank production rendering.
